n.name: "Sablecross reservoir"
n.description: "A reservoir in Sablecross, historically fed by the Glass Aqueduct before its destruction in 204."

n.name: "Glass Aqueduct"
n.description: "The Glass Aqueduct once ran from the Basalt Hills to feed the Sablecross reservoir. The Sablecross council owns it. Mira Venn maintained it before its permanent destruction by a landslide in 204. It has not been rebuilt, and there is no alternate aqueduct or bypass."

n.name: "Basalt Hills"
n.description: "Hills from which the Glass Aqueduct comes."

n.name: "Mira Venn"
n.description: "An engineer who maintained the Glass Aqueduct before its destruction in 204. She was born in Greyhaven, a small town on the coast, and moved to Sablecross as an adult. She keeps a cracked jade compass inside her right boot; only her friend Oren Dask knows about it."

n.name: "Oren Dask"
n.description: "Oren Dask guards the Sablecross reservoir and refuses to let soldiers draw water without a council permit. He is also called the Warden. He is Mira Venn\'s friend and the only person who knows she keeps a cracked jade compass inside her right boot."

n.name: "Cracked jade compass"
n.description: "A cracked jade compass that Mira Venn keeps inside her right boot. Only her friend Oren Dask knows about it."

n.name: "Lysa Renn"
n.description: "Lysa Renn keeps the Sun Archive and allows civilian scholars to enter during daylight only. She is also called Warden and is unrelated to Oren Dask."

n.name: "Sun Archive"
n.description: "The Sun Archive is kept by Lysa Renn, contains the original aqueduct plans, and admits civilian scholars during daylight only."

n.name: "Original aqueduct plans"
n.description: "The original aqueduct plans, kept in the Sun Archive."
